substantiveFindings: Owner pass over the complete chapter: all 355 Chinese units with both English fields, the 1 person, 2 mention rows, 9 claims, 288 preflight candidates (286 dispositioned; the remaining 2 are the Yuan Tong mention surfaces), the date audit (3 date items, 1 finding) and the 12 accepted editorial decisions.

No missing person or mention. The treatise is Datong calendar procedure; besides Yuan Tong it names only works (授時曆, 通軌, 曆經, 元志, 法原), reign periods (洪武, 至元) and technical terms, all correctly dispositioned. s0028 自沒其勤 refers to the unnamed Season Granting compilers collectively.

Chronology: the audit's finding is correct and concrete. s0010 洪武十七年甲子歲爲元 is the calendar epoch, and s0027 names Yuan Tong only to deny that he fixed the Tonggui offsets. The AD 1384 attestation (c0005), the date context on the negated event (c0008) and hint "AD 1384" convert an epoch into a personal date that the chapter does not support. A scoped change to the native undated representation is proposed. This preserves the true unknown and does not invent a replacement date; mingshi 031 is left for canonical certification.

Definite English errors in 26 units (43 field edits), all checkable against the chapter's own constants: mis-scaled or transposed numerals (s0068, s0070, s0078, s0123, s0160, s0195, s0201); 弱/強 and 少/太 fraction markers (s0025, s0197, s0199); technical misidentifications (入轉 as nodal entry in s0025; 正交 as true conjunction in s0026; 轉中 midpoint as the full cycle in s0080 and s0098; 中氣 as mean qi in s0108; 入交 as conjunction in s0110 and s0111; 交望 as quarter intervals in s0111; 交縮/交盈 as nodal in s0093; 春正/秋正 as first months in s0248); operand or pairing errors (s0106 surplus/rapid; s0156 next − previous); s0069's 'equal the era divisor'; per-day/per-limit errors (s0195, s0196); cross-references read as instructions (s0202, s0220); the idiomatic fields left unrepaired by accepted decisions r0005 (s0117) and r0006 (s0202); and a garbled romanization (s0175 娵訾).

Noted, not proposed: corrupt characters that the literal field mirrors and the idiomatic field already emends (s0153 人正, s0170 十五九八七, s0212 那得, s0228 症交, s0238 天限, s0295 大疾歷) are source-text matters, not translation errors. 日辰 after 命甲子算外 (s0063) is rendered "day and double-hour", which is debatable but not definite.
Identity: single local person; no merge question within the chapter. Canonical membership is a final-certification matter.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 《曆經》轉應一十三萬一千九百零四分，《通軌》載轉應一十三萬零二百零五分，實減一千六百九十九分，是入轉改遲一十七刻弱也。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: Calendar Classic rotation response 131,904 fen; Comprehensive Track records rotation response 130,205 fen—actually reducing 1,699 fen, which delayed entry into rotation by seventeen ke and a fraction.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Calendar Classic rotation response 131,904 fen; Comprehensive Track records rotation response 130,205 fen—actually reducing 1,699 fen, which delayed entry into rotation by just under seventeen ke.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 1,699 fen is 16.99 ke; 弱 marks a value just under the stated figure (as 強 in s0026 marks just over), not "and a fraction".

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 《曆經》轉應一十三萬一千九百零四分，《通軌》載轉應一十三萬零二百零五分，實減一千六百九十九分，是入轉改遲一十七刻弱也。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: The Calendar Classic gives a rotation offset of 131,904 parts; the Comprehensive Track records 130,205 parts—a reduction of 1,699 parts that delayed nodal entry by seventeen quarter-hours and a fraction.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: The Calendar Classic gives a rotation offset of 131,904 parts; the Comprehensive Track records 130,205 parts—a reduction of 1,699 parts that delayed entry into the lunar anomaly rotation by just under seventeen quarter-hours.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 入轉 is entry into the anomalistic rotation (轉), not nodal entry (交); and 一十七刻弱 is just under seventeen quarter-hours (1,699 parts = 16.99 ke).

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 累加弦策，各得弦望及次朔，如滿半歲周去之交縮，滿半周又去之即復交盈。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: Accumulate adding quarter-moon divisor; each obtain quarter-full moons and next new moon; if full half year circuit remove it for crossing contraction; full half circuit again remove it then again crossing expansion.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Accumulate adding quarter-moon divisor; each obtain quarter-full moons and next new moon; if full half year circuit remove it, passing into contraction; full half circuit again remove it then again passing into expansion.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 交縮 / 交盈 here mean passing over into the contraction / expansion half of the solar equation cycle (half-year removed); the procedure concerns solar expansion-contraction, not nodal crossings.

citation.excerpt: 如滿半歲周去之交縮，滿半周又去之即復交盈

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 累加弦策，各得弦望及次朔，如滿半歲周去之交縮，滿半周又去之即復交盈。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: Add the quarter-moon divisor repeatedly for each quarter- and full moon and successive conjunction; when half the tropical year is full, subtract it for nodal contraction; when half a cycle is full again, subtract once more to return to nodal expansion.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Add the quarter-moon divisor repeatedly for each quarter- and full moon and successive conjunction; when half the tropical year is full, subtract it and pass into contraction; when half a cycle is full again, subtract once more to return to expansion.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: "Nodal" contraction/expansion invents a lunar-node sense; 交 here is passing into the other half of the solar equation cycle.

definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Accumulate adding quarter-moon divisor; obtain quarter-full moons and next new moon; all full rotation midpoint remove it; slow and rapid alternate in succession.
